Using creative, data-driven perspectives, I bring clarity to complex problems. As a student of the liberal arts, I value a balanced and diverse skill set. I graduated summa cum laude from St. Olaf College in May, with distinction in Quantitative Economics. In my time at St. Olaf, you could have found me analyzing data on a consulting project for NASA, leading study sessions as a Teaching Assistant for St. Olaf's Economics Department, or using R to conduct independent research. 

My attention to detail, resilient mindset, and steady kindness have led me to numerous executive roles. In 2025-2026 I served as the president, flute section leader, and co-principal flutist for the St. Olaf Band, leading 99 members and advising our conductor, while fostering an inclusive culture. I also worked as a leader for St. Olaf’s Environmental Coalition, where our student-run organization used our ~$20,000 in funds to implement campus-wide sustainability projects. In my years as an organizer, Environmental Coalition planned over 50 events in partnership with over 20 different organizations, engaging around 700 students. 

Away from campus, I’ve studied abroad in Costa Rica, South Africa, Namibia, and Vietnam, exploring sustainability, political and social change, and economic development around the world. Engaging with students and locals, I deepened my appreciation for interdisciplinary perspectives.
